description: NaC₂H₄I(NO)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to two equivalent N and four equivalent O atoms to form corner-sharing NaN₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.62 Å. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Na-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N and one I atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. The C-I bond length is 2.28 Å. N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. I is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent C atoms.
